notes: Starting cards as posted under 'starting shyte': Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi, Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Visage Of The Emperor, Watto's Box, Boonta Eve Podrace, Sebulba's Podracer and Start Your Engines!; these count toward the total. Section headers ('starting shyte', 'dudes', 'locations', etc.) are not cards.
Posted 'visage of the destiny 7' (starting) and 'visage' (effects) both dested Visage Of The Emperor (destiny 7); two copies as published.

Posted 'suicide vader x2' is printed as written: several Darth Vader cards fit (likely Darth Vader With Lightsaber, which other DeckTech posts use for 'suicide runs'), and the post does not say which; same ruling as this author's deck 19835.

Posted 'huntdown' dested the Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi objective; 'choke vader' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'obsession' Vader's Obsession; 'twilek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'weapon lev' the Dark Cloud City Weapon Levitation; 'vader stick' Vader's Lightsaber; 'Omnibox+Its Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse.
Come Here You Big Coward, No Escape and Secret Plans are posted under effects and are the Effect printings (Defensive Shields came later).

Byline 'Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag' looks like a joke name (Geburtstag is German for birthday), so the deck is credited to the handle .prototype. with no player page, as with this author's decks 19835 and 19965.

The post says this is the list played 'on sunday' at an unnamed event (a close loss to 'luca'); the strategy updates suggest swaps (an Iggy with capture gun for a Mara) that are not applied to the list.
